label: Conic sections intro
subgoals: Recognize the hyperbola as a conic section

visual.title: A positive x² term opens left and right
visual.caption: For x²/a² − y²/b² = 1 the positive squared term names the transverse direction. Here x²/4 − y²/9 = 1 opens left and right, with vertices at (±2, 0) and asymptotes y = ±(3/2)x.

predict.question: Which way does x²/4 − y²/9 = 1 open?
predict.explain: The x² term is positive, so the transverse axis is horizontal. The branches cross the x-axis at (±2, 0) and approach the two asymptotes, not all four directions.
